hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq -- '--force(-with-lease)?|(^| )-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*( |$)'; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Force-push denied by a PreToolUse hook (CLAUDE.md / .claude/rules/guardrails.md, #101 layer 0): never force-push without the user explicitly asking for it in this session."}}'; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Fq -e 'OWNER: APPROVED' -e 'OWNER: REJECTED'; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"No agent ever writes an OWNER: APPROVED / OWNER: REJECTED marker (CLAUDE.md, #101 layer 0) - only the human owner writes these, in the GitHub UI."}}'; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Fq 'api.github.com' && printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Fq -e 'OWNER: APPROVED' -e 'OWNER: REJECTED'; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"No agent ever writes an OWNER: APPROVED / OWNER: REJECTED marker (CLAUDE.md, #101 layer 0) - only the human owner writes these, in the GitHub UI."}}'; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); unq=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | tr -d '\047"'); if printf '%s' "$unq" | grep -Eq '>>[[:space:]]*([^[:space:]]*/)?WORKLOG\.md([[:space:]]|$)'; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"WORKLOG.md at the repo root is retired (#98): nothing appends to it again. See docs/worklog/ and BACKLOG.md - Where a record goes."}}'; fi

fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); base=$(basename "$fp" 2>/dev/null); dir=$(dirname "$fp" 2>/dev/null); if [ "$base" = "WORKLOG.md" ] && { [ "$dir" = "." ] || [ "$dir" = "$(pwd)" ]; }; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"WORKLOG.md at the repo root is retired (#98): nothing writes to it again. See docs/worklog/ and BACKLOG.md - Where a record goes."}}'; fi

body=$(jq -r '.tool_input.body // empty'); printf '%s' "$body" | node -e 'let b="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>b+=d);process.stdin.on("end",()=>{const norm=s=>s.replace(/[\p{Cf}\p{Cc}\p{Default_Ignorable_Code_Point}ㅤ️]+/gu,"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();const strict=norm(b);const loose=norm(b.replace(/[*_`>#]/g,"")).toUpperCase();if(/^OWNER: ?APPROVED/.test(strict)||/^OWNER: ?REJECTED/.test(loose)){process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"No agent ever writes an OWNER: APPROVED / OWNER: REJECTED marker (CLAUDE.md, #101 layer 0) - only the human owner writes these, in the GitHub UI. This MCP tool call would have posted one at the start of its body, the same shape scripts/review-gate.mjs treats as a real verdict - not just a mention of the marker in prose. Strict/loose checks delete every character in the UNION of Unicode Cf (format), Cc (control) and Default_Ignorable_Code_Point, plus Hangul filler U+3164 and variation selector U+FE0F, wherever they sit in the body - a union, not a swap, because round five replaced Cf/Cc with Default_Ignorable_Code_Point and silently dropped real Cf characters (Egyptian Hieroglyph format controls, Interlinear Annotation marks) that Default_Ignorable does not cover - then collapses remaining ordinary whitespace to a single space, so no zero-width or format character anywhere in the marker can break the match while GitHub still renders it invisibly (#221 sixth review)."}}));}});'

d=$(jq -r 'if (.tool_input.method == "update") and (.tool_input.issue_number == 62) and (((.tool_input.body // "") | test("(^|\n)- second item: ")) | not) then "1" else "0" end'); if [ "$d" = "1" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"The routine heartbeat (issue #62) must carry a - second item: line naming whether a second item was taken and, if not, which of the four #97 conditions failed. This update body is missing it."}}'; fi

d=$(jq -r 'if (.tool_input.labels // []) | index("frozen") then "1" else "0" end'); if [ "$d" = "1" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"The frozen label is retired (CLAUDE.md / .claude/rules/governance.md, #101 layer 0): the code-health freeze the owner lifted on 2026-09-10 (issue #36) is a one-time event that does not re-arm, and no run may apply the frozen label to any issue to reinstate it. Only the owner decides to freeze work again, and that decision does not go through this label."}}'; fi
